column1: # Purpose: Maia's simplified ONNX export carries zero history planes, so it
# cannot condition on "you just played this exact sacrifice" — a forced-
# sacrifice follow-up gets an unconditional prior, as if a random player at
# the search ELO were teleported cold into the position (verified on game
# analysis.md`; confirmed NOT a sign bug). At a WDL leaf the value comes from
# the SAME network as the priors, so the search loses its only external check
# on this known blind spot (D-03). A REGRESSION HERE BLOCKS PHASE 197 — see
# `reports/leaf-wdl/accept-rule.md` Gate A. Do not retune this fixture to make
#   fen           the position to move from
#   correct_move  the objectively-best move in UCI, independently verified
#                 (below) to be Stockfish's own top MultiPV choice at depth 20
#   eval_gap_cp   |eval(correct_move) - eval(runner_up)| at that same depth,
#                 in mover-POV cp-equivalent units (mate scores substituted at
#                 so a near-tie position can never silently weaken the gate
#   note          why Maia's history-blind policy is expected to underrate
#   source        provenance: either the verified game-687537 anchor, or a
#                 lichess CC0 puzzle already committed at
# Every FEN below parses as a legal position and every recorded move is legal
# never by eye — Gate A §4a). Every recorded move was additionally confirmed
# to be Stockfish's own depth-20 MultiPV top choice (not merely "a" sacrifice)
# via a one-off headless-Stockfish verification pass over this exact file,

column5: Queen sac (Qxh2+) starts a forced perpetual (Rh6+, Bh2+, Bg3+...); Maia-2600 rates the required follow-up Rh6+ only 28% raw / 31% post-truncation with no move-history conditioning, vs 56% for the losing Rxd1 line — verified project note 2026-07-10, confirmed not a sign bug.

column5: The critical follow-up itself, one ply after the sac (after 24...Qxh2+ 25.Kxh2): Rh6+ is the only move that keeps the perpetual alive. This is exactly the node where Maia's lack of history planes bites — it has no way to know the queen sac two plies ago was the *point* of this rook lift.
